title: hive prune output (v1)
description: Stable contract emitted by `hive prune --json`. Drops every registry entry in ~/Dev/hive/config.yml whose row is invalid, whose `path` no longer points at a directory on disk, or whose stored realpath no longer matches the current target for that path. With `--dry-run` the registry is not rewritten and the would-be-removed list is returned for inspection.

dry_run.description: true when invoked with --dry-run; the registry is not rewritten.

removed.description: Entries that were (or would have been) dropped because their row is invalid, their path no longer points at a directory, or their stored realpath no longer matches the current target.

error_class.description: Short name (no module prefix) of the Hive::Error subclass that was raised. Matches every other hive-* error envelope.

error_kind.description: usage = Thor rejected the argv shape before command dispatch. config = malformed config.yml or missing $HIVE_HOME (exit 78). internal = uncategorised crash (exit 70).
